Inclusion Criteria:
  -  full-term (≥ 37 weeks of gestation)
  -  singleton
  -  vertex-presenting gestations
  -  with no contraindication to vaginal delivery
  -  intact membranes
  -  Bishop score  [AND] < 7 and cervical dilation ≤2 cm
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  contraindication for misoprostol
  -  history of previous caesarean
  -  rupture of membranes,
  -  fetal  [OR] or maternal morbidities (fetal major abnormalities, FIGO definition of pathological CTG, [OR]  HELLP syndrome, [OR]  preeclampsia  [OR] or hypertension with severe features, fetal growth restriction)
